subject: BridgePoint: Incident notification, IRP evidence onboarding, and postmortem delivery
messages:
From: Claire Meyer <claire.meyer@bridgepointhealth.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: victor.chen@bridgepointhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-04T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unusual auth failures in staging - asking for IRP and evidence

Hi Jordan,

We observed a spike in SSO failures affecting a subset of BridgePoint staging users between 07:05 and 07:22 PDT this morning. Our engineers saw failed JWT validation from a set of IPs we don't recognize; we have quarantined the sessions and there is no sign of customer data exfiltration, but we'd like to treat this as a security event while we investigate.

BridgePoint requires the following to complete our internal review and update our SIG/CAIQ mapping for the integration:
- A copy of Redwood's incident response plan (IRP) relevant sections for authentication/identity events
- A redacted telemetry sample (trace/log snippet) showing the failed token validations and any downstream error codes
- A SOC 2 evidence manifest (control IDs affected, sample artifacts and retention notes)
- Confirmation of any config changes/deploys in the last 48 hours that could be related

Can you confirm receipt and an ETA for these artifacts? We have a table-top review with our security council tomorrow and would like to include Redwood's materials. If you need an NDA or a secure upload link, let us know — we can provide both.

Thanks,
Claire Meyer
Security Program Manager
BridgePoint Health

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Meyer <claire.meyer@bridgepointhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-04T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual auth failures in staging - asking for IRP and evidence

Hi Claire — thanks for flagging this and for the clear list. I’ve looped in our security/compliance team (Marissa and Ben) and we’ll prioritize a concise artifact package for your review.

Quick notes / next steps:
- We will provide an IRP excerpt covering authentication incidents + escalation contacts (PDF) and a short postmortem summary once we complete the triage.
- We will extract a redacted telemetry sample (remove IPs and user IDs) and include a short explanation of the observed error codes.
- We’ll generate a SOC 2 evidence manifest that maps affected controls to available artifacts and retention windows.
- ETA: initial package by EOD PT today; full postmortem within 48 hours.

If BridgePoint prefers a secure upload instead of e-mail attachments, please send the DocuSign/portal link and we’ll push artifacts there.

Would you like a 30-minute screen-share at 11:00 PT to walk the council through the artifacts? I can host and Marissa can join for technical detail.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0179

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: BridgePoint incident — assemble IRP artifacts and telemetry sample

Team — forwarding BridgePoint’s request. They want an IRP excerpt, a redacted telemetry sample showing failed JWT validations, SOC 2 evidence manifest, and any recent config/deploy notes. Priorities:
1) Marissa — redact and prepare the IRP excerpt (authentication incident section). Include our escalation contacts and SLA fallback policy.
2) Ben — pull a 1-minute telemetry sample (07:05–07:22 PDT) and redact IPs and user identifiers; include a short write-up mapping error codes to internal handlers.
3) Lauren — update the SOC 2 evidence manifest CSV with control IDs, artifact filenames, retention, and redaction notes.

Important constraints:
- Artifacts need to be safe for sharing under standard NDA; do not include raw IP lists or full request bodies.
- Mark clearly any items that require BridgePoint to sign the upload agreement for access.

Target: Package (IRP PDF, telemetry_sample_redacted.log, soc2-evidence-manifest.csv, sig-caiaq-mapping.csv) ready by 16:00 PT. I’ll coordinate delivery to the BridgePoint secure portal unless Claire asks for different.

Thanks — Jordan

Attachments (stubs for internal tracking): irp_draft_notes.md, telemetry_query.sql
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Meyer <claire.meyer@bridgepointhealth.com>, Victor Chen <victor.chen@bridgepointhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-04T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: BridgePoint — incident artifacts and short postmortem (initial)

Claire / Victor — attaching the artifact package we discussed. Below is a short summary and links to the secure bundle.

Summary (initial, non-public):
- Event window: 2027-10-04 07:05–07:22 PDT.
- Impact: ~0.4% of BridgePoint staging auth attempts failed with token validation error (jwt_exp_claim_mismatch). No sign of data exfiltration; requests originated from transient IPs that do not map to known Redwood infra.
- Likely cause: an intermittent validator mismatch during a dependent library deploy (rollback performed during triage). We have a follow-up task to add stricter pre-deploy validation around validator config.

What’s in the secure bundle (links below):
- redwood_irp_summary_bridgepoint_20271004.pdf — excerpt from our incident response plan covering authentication events, escalation contacts, and forensic procedures.
- telemetry_sample_redacted.log — 30-line redacted trace showing the failed validations and error codes (IPs and user identifiers removed).
- soc2-evidence-manifest.csv — control mapping and artifact locations.
- sig-caiaq-mapping.csv — high-level mapping to SIG/CAIQ questions you referenced.
- postmortem_link.txt — link to the internal postmortem (will be shared read-only after BridgePoint’s NDA is confirmed).

Secure access: We uploaded the bundle to the BridgePoint secure portal (HubSpot:BRIDGE-4291). If you prefer DocuSign or an alternate SFTP, we can re-send.

Next steps:
- We will complete a full postmortem with timeline and corrective actions within 48 hours and share the read-only document.
- Offer: if you want, we can schedule a technical walkthrough (30 min) next week to go through the telemetry and control mappings.
- If BridgePoint requires a signed NDA for the postmortem, please send the link; we’ll countersign immediately.

Please reply with any additional artifact formats you need (e.g., raw logs under a stricter agreement).

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments (delivered as secure bundle): redwood_irp_summary_bridgepoint_20271004.pdf (PDF), telemetry_sample_redacted.log (log), soc2-evidence-manifest.csv (CSV), sig-caiaq-mapping.csv (CSV)
